values.description: Paid Kill Coins purchased with real money. The editor never increases this value.

values.description: Energy currency stored in the SPL tank and spent on waiting room facility upgrades.

values.description: Currency earned from defeated Haters; used for special exchanges.

values.label: Player Rank
values.description: Player rank shown in the waiting room.

values.description: Rank points. The game derives the displayed rank from this value.

values.description: Free continues available in the Tower of Barbs.

values.description: Maximum free continues stored for the Tower of Barbs.

values.label: Login streak
values.description: Consecutive login bonus days.

values.description: 1 while the Royal Express VIP pass is active, 0 otherwise.

values.description: Unix timestamp of when the Royal Express VIP pass expires.

values.description: Royal Express pass type.
